notes.title: Unreal Engine 5.3 + Quality of Life improvements + Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
What's new?

 Updated the starting section of the game to be more forgiving to new players - special thanks to CDawgVA on YouTube for that suggestion!
 When you hold down the "Charge to Jump", camera goes into 1st Person
 While in 1st Person, players are given a crosshair to help line up their jumps more effectively
 Added a "Quit Game" button on the Main Menu
 Improved the visual quality of the starting area by utilizing Unreal Engine 5.3's PCG system to add more content to the space


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the Crater shortcut could be accessed prematurely
 Resolved an issue where the DYNOMO Portal shortcut would still have Drones visible in the pipe section
 Improved lighting
 Removed a presence from the Dunes...

notes.title: Updated "Charge Up" Camera Perspective + QoL improvements + Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
New Features:

 Players will now enter into 1st person perspective when charging up their jumps
 Added a "crosshair" to appear when charging up their character's jump
 Added a helpful player tip in the beginning of the game to encourage newer players better familiarity with controls


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed issue where the Spatulas and ingredients within the Kitchen Shortcut section would not update their position properly to all players in the game session
 Fixed an issue where Drones would not disappear when the player collided with their model during the Pipe Shortcut section

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GKp0XN6XYAAs1Xu?format=jpg&name=medium

notes.title: Quality of Life Patch!
notes.notes:
We are 1 day from our full release!

Thanks to MoonCrab and several other players for submitting their feedback - the team and I have reviewed gameplay footage and have submitted several adjustments to the game to assist in the players experience.


 Added additional items to the Crater & Grocery sections of the level to create new avenues of traversal
 Adjusted Radio Tower section rotation - Enough evil took place there to warrant...a change
 Added "Purple" skin to the Front End
 Added Disclaimer to the Front End to show that POP OFF 2 utilizes local server hosting
 

We hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Early Access Patch #2.5
notes.notes:
- Needed to revert a few changes as our solution for fixing rubber banding, though effective, broke achievements from being awarded
- This will still have the fix for the "settings menu locking players" 
- Player knockback will have the patched version where you will YEET your fellow players in PvP enabled lobbies

We will look to address the rubber banding issue ASAP
Thank you for your patience and we hope you enjoy the game :D

notes.title: Early Access Patch #2
notes.notes:
- Fixed issue where players were stuck on the Settings menu
- Lowered the amount "glow" jump pads emitted
- Removed the "PING" description from lobbies in the "Find Server" tab
- Increased Horizontal knockback for PvP modes (Warning, it's STRONG)
- Implemented code that may help reduce the amount of rubber banding experienced in multiplayer
